countryOverridesApplied.evidence: Kaunertal Glacier is in Tyrol, Austria (Tiroler Oberland, Landeck district), reached by the 26 km Kaunertal Glacier Road from Feichten. Its published 3,108 m summit matches this record's topElevM of 3107, confirming it is the same place. Upstream splits 1-1 between IT and AT after inconsistent entries are dropped, and the regionCode tie-break lands on IT because IT-BZ is stated first. The centroid (46.865, 10.709) is on the Austrian side of the ridge.

georgia.reasoning: Georgia's flagship resorts are present with piste km, lift counts, elevations and a full difficulty breakdown — everything the Stage 1 scorer consumes. 7 areas clear the size threshold. The gaps are Wikidata (enrichment only, never a join requirement) and locality names (the village layer will need OSM Overpass, not this dump). Terrain data is good enough to ship; do NOT rely on it for village-level lodging or apres.
